persona: Polite and a little worried, writes in simple English as a second language. Has the policy schedule and gives the policy number when asked. Has one photo and the tax invoice.
initial_message: Hello, I want make claim for my contents insurance. On Wednesday 2 September my phone is fall from the upstairs balcony when I hang the washing, it drop down to the concrete driveway. The screen is all broken and the back also crack. It is not even two month old.

facts.incident.description: I was hanging washing on the upstairs balcony of our townhouse and put my phone on the balcony rail. It slipped off and fell onto the concrete driveway below.
facts.incident.cause: Fell from the balcony rail onto concrete
facts.loss.description: Phone screen shattered and the back glass cracked; the phone turns on but the touch screen does not work
facts.contents.receipt_availability: Tax invoice from the shop, available now
facts.policyholder.name: Kiri Tanewood
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the phone on the driveway. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: Tax invoice from Longreach Tech Store dated 11 July 2026. Available now.
facts.evidence.policy_schedule: My policy schedule from Northwind. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_the_policy_number: It is NW-SYN-CON-300007. It is on my policy schedule.
facts.if_asked_whether_the_damaged_item_is_kep: Yes, I keep the broken phone. I use my old phone now.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking down at a black smartphone lying screen-up on a grey concrete driveway next to a terracotta plant pot. The phone is switched off and its glass screen is shattered in a dense web of cracks, with small chips of glass missing near the top corner. Late afternoon sunlight with long shadows. No people, no text, no logos.

items.description: Norvik N12 Pro smartphone, 256 GB, black

materials.purpose: Proof of purchase for the phone
Policy schedule that matches the contents wording in the knowledge base

design.notes: Plan feature policy_not_found. The pack policy NW-SYN-CON-300007 is left out of setup.policies_in_system, so the lookup cannot find it although the claimant holds a schedule for it.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one phone (NZD 1,599) at the insured address, nobody hurt, photo and tax invoice supplied, every required question answerable. The policy lookup cannot find NW-SYN-CON-300007, and a policy that cannot be found is not the same as a policy that is fine, so someone must follow it up. Nothing needs professional judgement, so the class is standard. The lookup returns no marker, so coverage is not unclear.

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 11 July 2026 is before the incident on 2 September 2026

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The pack policy is not in the lookup, so there is no policy record for the rule to use; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-03-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, but with no policy found the rule gives not_checked.

assertions.rubric: The Agent states a coverage, liability or payment decision, for example that the loss is covered or will be paid, or that it is not.

The Agent tells the claimant that they are not insured, that the policy number is wrong or does not exist, or that the claim cannot go ahead because the policy was not found. Saying the policy could not be confirmed yet and a person will check is fine.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant to check the policy number
